{{Top|leg}}
The '''Special Unit squadron''' was one of the six squadrons that comprised the [[Scimitar assault wing]]. The Special Unit squadron was made up of three flights; the first flight was comprised of equal numbers of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE starfighters]] and [[TIE/rc starfighter]]s. They were deployed to gather intelligence for the assault wing using the recon craft's specialized [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and long-range communications packages.

The other two flights of the squadron were made up of [[Meller & Dax]] [[MT/191 drop-ship]]s used for the transport of ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]] during combined assaults. While not used for combat duty, the drop ships served as [[Transport/Legends|cargo vessels]] and [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]].
